messages:
eden: Heads-up: Cust 'EuroBank' wants an EU-only POC but also insists on APAC standby for latency-sensitive sessions. They explicitly asked for a per-region subprocess list, BYOK in Azure (westeurope), and a written 'no-US-egress' guarantee in the contract. Kickoff window: two weeks.

sasha: FYI, for EU-only with APAC standby we can do tenant pinning to eu-west plus a standby routing group in asia-southeast1. That preserves EU data for primary traffic. Standby only takes traffic on explicit failover or session affinity migration.

jaime: Technical note: BYOK works with Azure Key Vault in westeurope. We'll need a service principal and a managed identity from the customer. Also need to confirm allowed key wrap algos. I'll add steps to the SRE checklist.

eden: Can legal accept "no-US-egress"? They want firm language.

security-bot: Subprocessor snapshot: AWS eu-west-1, GCP europe-west2, Azure westeurope, Akamai EU CDN. For Dedicated deployments, subproc list depends on customer infra. PDF attestation link: /attachments/subproc_eu_2026_Q1.pdf

ops-bot: Playbook created: /playbooks/eurobank-poc-2026/tasks. Daily syncs scheduled, owners assigned: @jaime (BYOK), @sasha (routing), @eden (legal).

jaime: Ops caveat: to enforce 'no-US-egress' we must pin routing and ensure failover regions are non-US. However, network-level transits could still touch US peering points depending on ISP paths. Recommend legal-approved phrasing: 'No intentional egress to the US regions; transient backbone routing through US-based exchange points is possible and out of scope.'

sasha: Pricing delta: Reserved dedicated capacity + BYOK + standby region = +38% vs hosted baseline for a 90-day POC at stated QPS. I'll upload model assumptions.

eden: Ok plan: 1) Send subproc attestation + BYOK steps, 2) propose legal wording per Jaime, 3) attach SOW with hint at price delta, 4) schedule kickoff if customer signs.

eden: Quick ask — can someone prepare a short network diagram (EU primary, APAC standby, keyvault in westeurope) for legal & infra? Need it by EOD Thursday.

jaime: I'll sketch diagram and add required firewall rules and peering notes.

sasha: I'll prepare routing failure mode doc: preferred->eu-west, fallback->eu-quantized-same-region variant, escalate to APAC standby only on region-wide outage.

eden: Perfect. Thanks all. Will loop legal and the customer. :handshake:
